share_basis.denominator: raw CRSP dsf.prc (abs; negative prc is the bid/ask flag)
share_basis.why_the_check_cannot_be_the_fix: cfacpr(t) is the cumulative factor to the END of the sample, so the rescale multiplies by the same future quantity it is trying to remove

hand_verified_row.name: AAPL
hand_verified_row.note: cfacpr 28 = the 7:1 of 2014 times the 4:1 of 2020

share_basis_headline.reading: ratio_adj_check = mean_target_adj * cfacpr(t) / close reproduces the PIT ratio on 93.01% of rows and fails on 6.99%. That is why the RESCALE IS NOT THE FIX: cfacpr(t) is the cumulative factor to the end of the sample, so the correction multiplies by the same future quantity it removes (a verified re-derivation left the rescaled toxic cell at -20.3%/yr t -2.70, i.e. still contaminated). The fix is to read the unadjusted file.
share_basis_headline.hand_check: AAPL permno 14593, statpers 2013-06-20: adjusted 19.323, unadjusted 541.04, cfacpr 28.0, panel close 413.50 -> the rebuilt panel row carries ratio 1.30844 where the old tape carried 0.0467

performance_codes.why_not_400_591: 400-591 counts liquidations (450) and administrative codes and dilutes the mean from -24.63% to -19.57%

delisting_notes.why: crsp.dsf.ret is NOT delisting-inclusive. Of the 1,114 events coded 400-591 in 2013-24, 1,103 have a dsf bar on dlstdt and exactly 4 carry ret == dlret; mean dsf.ret on those bars is -9.2% against mean dlret -19.6%.
delisting_notes.why_not_400_591: the review's stated 400-591 range gives n=1,114 and mean -19.57% because code 450 (liquidation, n=216, mean -0.74%) dilutes it. 400-489 is kept as its own documented category and is NOT Shumway-filled.
delisting_notes.unfilled_on_purpose: a merger / exchange / liquidation with no CRSP dlret gets dl_factor 1.0 and dlret_source 'none'. That is 'not measured', not 'the holder got their money back'; inventing a wind-up return would be a fabrication and the count is in by_category.with_crsp_dlret.

universe_coverage.screen_definition: shrcd in (10, 11) and exchcd in (1, 2, 3), name window overlaps
universe_coverage.verdict: a complete SUBSET of the screen, not a superset

universe_verdict: The dsf pull holds 6,894 distinct permnos over 2013-2024; a full shrcd in (10,11) / exchcd in (1,2,3) screen of the same window holds 6,909. ZERO pulled permnos fall outside the screen and 15 screened permnos (0.22%) are absent from the pull. So the earlier '6,894-permno screened superset' characterisation is REFUTED: it is a 99.7829%-complete SUBSET, materially all 10/11, and a re-pull is not warranted. assert_universe_coverage() now REFUSES below 99% and names the missing permnos rather than describing them.

rules.one_definition: close/coverage floors are learner.prior.has_opinion, imported not re-implemented

hygiene.on_failure: the row is KEPT (deleting it is survivorship bias) but ratio/upside/log_ratio are NULL and band is no_opinion

rebucketing_census.rows: old band (adjusted target / raw close) -> new band (PIT)

rebucketing_reconciliation.note: The census above applies the FULL new hygiene (price, coverage, ratio>=50, split-year). Re-running the same crosstab with the price/coverage floors ONLY reproduces the review's numbers exactly, which is the cross-check that the two derivations agree.

prior_status.meaning: prior_*/resid_* columns are carried for schema continuity. They are NOT expectations until B1.5 re-derives BAND_PRIOR from this panel; nothing may read them as an expected excess return.
prior_status.corrected_toxic_cell_is_not_a_signal: the corrected toxic_ge_5 cell measures +37.4%/yr t 1.94 on ~7 names/month, but 84.1% of it trades under $5 (median close $3.08), a $5 floor flips it to -31.6%/yr t -1.41, its median monthly excess is -0.86% against a mean of +2.69%, 2022-24 is +0.7%/yr t 0.03, and 27.6% still carries a future reverse split (+56pp when those are dropped). A right-tail cell in a thin, cheap corner is not a location shift and must not be carried as a long.
